reason: Mixing weathered rock with water seems like a practical first step toward making paint for the animal picture.
expectation: I expect a pigment or paint mixture, though it may need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: A call in the cave might help make a song, but I want to start with painting.

effect: The rock and water made pigment ready to mark the cave wall, so I can proceed with painting.
reaction: Satisfying: the paint came together as expected.
reason: Place the pigment in the cave to start the animal picture.
expectation: I expect the pigment to be available at the cave for painting; the imagined animal may need another step.

effect: The pigment is in the cave, and two painting combinations are now available.
reason: Try the stars with pigment to make an imagined picture rather than one based on memory.
expectation: I expect a star-inspired painting, possibly an animal that does not exist, though I am guessing.

alternatives.reason: Memory might also inspire an animal picture, but stars seem more suggestive of an invented creature.

effect: The stars produced an imagined sky, not the animal, so I will try memory with the pigment.
reaction: The painted sky was a plausible result, though it did not advance the stated animal goal.
reason: Memory may provide an animal image to paint or develop into an imagined creature.
expectation: I expect an animal painting based on memory, possibly requiring another step to make it imaginary.

alternatives.reason: The cave call could advance the song, but I want to finish the picture first.

effect: Memory produced a painting of a real remembered animal; combining it with a story may turn it into an invented one.
reaction: The result makes sense, though the imaginary animal still needs another step.
reason: Combine the painting with a story to develop an animal that does not exist.
expectation: I expect the story to transform or inspire the painted animal into an imaginary creature, though I am not certain.

effect: The story turned the remembered animal painting into an invented beast, completing the painting goal.
reaction: Satisfying to see familiar features rearranged into something new.
reason: Use the call in the cave to work toward the remaining song goal.
expectation: I expect the cave to change or echo the call, perhaps providing a starting point for a song.

alternatives.reason: Sharing discovery through story fits the teaching theme, but the song is an active goal.

effect: The call produced an echo, which can now be combined with memory to continue toward a song.
reaction: The cave echo behaved as expected.
reason: Combine the echo with memory to develop the repeated sound into a song.
expectation: I expect a remembered or repeated sound pattern, possibly a song; I am not sure whether it will take another step.

alternatives.reason: Sharing discovery through a story fits the teaching theme, but the song remains an active goal.

effect: The echo and memory made a song, completing that goal and revealing a teaching goal.
reaction: The remembered rhythm is a satisfying link between echo and song.
reason: Shared discovery and story are the only offered combination and seem suited to passing knowledge on.
expectation: I expect the community to retell its discovery so others can learn from it.

effect: The shared discovery and story produced teaching, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: The emphasis on explaining evidence and practising skills made the ending meaningful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Turning a remembered animal into an imagined beast was satisfying: it showed how familiar features can be rearranged to create something new.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment was a straightforward preparation rather than an interesting decision on its own.

surprise.text: Stars and pigment made an imagined sky rather than the imaginary animal I had guessed at.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, although I was guessing when I chose stars for the animal picture.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the links between making, imagination and teaching were engaging, even if some preparations were routine.
